status: ART ONLY. Native rendering, acquisition, catalog enablement and gameplay powers require independent integration acceptance.
rights: Original code-native pixel geometry. No Nintendo or other game art, tracing, downloaded raster reference, or raster-generated creature input.

briefs.name: Coalcoil
briefs.silhouette: A low snail with a broad smiling muzzle, two blunt eyestalks and a sideways crescent shell; pale foot clearly separate from charcoal shell.
briefs.locomotion: Foot ripples in four readable waves; shell rocks after the head stops.

briefs.name: Emberhelix
briefs.silhouette: A raised snail on a narrow long foot; its open spiral shell sits upright with a large triangular window and expressive face below.
briefs.locomotion: Stretch, brace, pull the shell forward; spiral tips lag by one pose.

briefs.name: Hearthcrown
briefs.silhouette: A long muscular snail with a flat fan-shaped shell held above its face on three connected shell ribs; large open spaces replace the earlier spiral.
briefs.locomotion: Wide foot fans to anchor, then contracts into an unhurried glide.

briefs.name: Shardibex
briefs.silhouette: A small round-nosed mountain goat with short straight stone horns, wide cloven feet and a tilted rectangular shoulder patch.
briefs.locomotion: Quick paired hoof plants, head dip, rear-foot catch-up.

briefs.name: Bracehorn
briefs.silhouette: A low broad-shouldered goat with huge outward U-curved horns enclosing its face, short hindquarters and distinctly spread forehooves.
briefs.locomotion: Three-beat brace and short forward shuffle; head stays level.

briefs.name: Spanram
briefs.silhouette: A tall long-legged ram with two high buttress horns joining above its brow, a narrow waist and two strong negative-space arches.
briefs.locomotion: High deliberate diagonal hoof steps; horns sway opposite hips.

briefs.name: Tuftpika
briefs.silhouette: A tiny pika with long swept-back grass whiskers, round ears, a square leafy tail tuft and two high-set dark eyes.
briefs.locomotion: Compact four-paw gallop, pause, whisker flick.

briefs.name: Rootmuffle
briefs.silhouette: A low long-bodied pika with a broad root beard and two separated leafy shoulder mounds; its ears and living muzzle remain exposed.
briefs.locomotion: Low belly-clear scamper; beard trails, then gathers beneath chin.

briefs.name: Sporevault
briefs.silhouette: An upright long-hindleg pika with a closed pinecone tail carried above its head and a tiny chest between large open arm spaces.
briefs.locomotion: Crouch, tall hop, two-foot settle; tail opens only during casting.

briefs.name: Chalklung
briefs.silhouette: A living porous sponge with three soft lobed feet, one angled chimney and a friendly face on its lower flexible skirt.
briefs.locomotion: Three-foot rocking walk; chimney compresses and rebounds as it breathes.

briefs.name: Bellcup
briefs.silhouette: A tall sponge with an inverted bell mouth, a long curved neck, broad two-lobed base and a face looking out beneath the rim.
briefs.locomotion: Leans forward on the base, straightens neck, then draws the base underneath.

briefs.name: Runnelribbon
briefs.silhouette: A flat ribbon sponge with two raised breathing sails, four stub feet and a living face at one blunt leading corner.
briefs.locomotion: Sideways inchworm fold, unfold and soft skirt sweep.

briefs.name: Orelet
briefs.silhouette: A round mole with a pale snout, narrow metallic digging nails and one smooth ore nodule at the tip of its very short tail.
briefs.locomotion: Alternating outward forepaw scoops with its feet visibly above the ground.

briefs.name: Augermole
briefs.silhouette: A long wedge-bodied mole whose broad serrated forepaws frame a low face; its body tapers into a small straight tail.
briefs.locomotion: Wide shoulder crawl with nails swept behind during recovery.

briefs.name: Pendulumole
briefs.silhouette: An upright mole with long forearms, broad planted hindfeet and an elongated heavy tail curved into a counterweight loop.
briefs.locomotion: Two hindfoot steps then tail counter-swing; face aims independently of arms.

briefs.name: Ashkite
briefs.silhouette: A planthopper with a broad kite-shaped shell, very short antennae, tucked legs and a visible round face below a shallow hood.
briefs.locomotion: Tiny spring hop, side slip and four-foot landing.

briefs.name: Plumehopper
briefs.silhouette: A tall long-legged hopper with a narrow upright plume, a pear-shaped abdomen and an open diamond between its rear legs.
briefs.locomotion: High tucked-leg spring, upright hover beat and heel-first landing.

briefs.name: Huskdrifter
briefs.silhouette: A broad leaf-shaped hopper held horizontally beneath translucent folded shell sails, with a small face extending beyond their front edge.
briefs.locomotion: Low skirt-like glide with visible occasional leg taps; not a permanent flight permission.

briefs.name: Screepeek
briefs.silhouette: A stocky tapir with a short mobile trunk, small round ears, heavy hindquarters and three pale pebble pads along its shoulder.
briefs.locomotion: Slow alternating four-foot stroll; trunk probes ahead on the idle beat.

briefs.name: Stairtrunk
briefs.silhouette: A long-trunked tapir with stepped flaring ears, high shoulders and low hindquarters, leaving a clear diagonal back silhouette.
briefs.locomotion: Forefoot reach, trunk curl, broad rear step; ears fold on recovery.

briefs.name: Mossmarch
briefs.silhouette: A short six-legged caterpillar-like animal with a square muzzle, four separated moss cushions and a bare expressive brow.
briefs.locomotion: Six legs ripple in three pairs while cushions squash in sequence.

briefs.name: Trellislong
briefs.silhouette: A long high-arched six-legged crawler with an open lattice of connected moss ribs above its smooth living underside and wide face.
briefs.locomotion: Three alternating leg pairs carry a traveling body arch, never a static stretched base sprite.

briefs.name: Dripurchin
briefs.silhouette: A low sea-urchin-like animal with a soft visible face, five blunt movable spines and three rounded tube feet.
briefs.locomotion: Rotates its feet without rotating its face, then bobs with gathered droplets.

briefs.name: Dewmedusa
briefs.silhouette: A tall soft-bodied urchin with its five spines opened into curved umbrella ribs and long joined tube-foot tassels; face hangs below the cap.
briefs.locomotion: Gentle pulse-lift then trailing-foot settle; a grounded shadow makes its location legible.
